notes.title: Saranity Alpha V4.0.0 released
notes.content:
[h1]Saranity Alpha V 4.0.0 is released. [/h1]

The update comes with a lot of fixes and resolved issues. Also a lot of community feedback has been processed into this update. For the full release notes see below patch notes. 

[h3]New Map: Bridges[/h3]

This means we have a new map as the single player LVL 4 map which is called bridges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37717548/077394ccf4d2a8ef454f376a47e547d489557ec7.jpg[/img]

Bridges is a map that features the center core located just offshore of some Island, on some ancient ruins. Some of the Ruins feature booby-traps that can be used to attack the incoming waves. As the bridges extend a full square , the incoming waves can always divert to a other path. This is the first map with [b]medium[/b] difficulty meaning all units can spawn and slammer waves have a medium chance of being added to a wave.

Who will be the first person to clear this map ??? And be crowned the best player.

[h3]Release notes version Alpha V4.0.0[/h3]

Saranity developer initiated:

  - UI:
    - Added patch notes menu
    - Update Single player scoreboard menu to reflect correct text.
    - Removed default player save state. This will prompt for player name on 
      game start if not set.
    - Updated host / Join menus to include Discord channel
    - Updated the Single player menu with info about the levels and enemies
    - Added a Tutorial button to single player menu

  - Single Player:
    - Name and music did not load correct from stored profile. Now fix by 
       loading 
    - Profile also for single player.
    - Added Tutorial map option to give new players a intro to the game and 
       how to build and upgrade towers.
   
  - Levels
    - Added New Level "Bridges" for the Single player mode. This level is now 
       Level 4 and add dynamic level based traps.

  - Units
    - Grunt
      - Added new visual trails for skill 1 and 3 
      - increased range of skill 3 with 50% This will also give more control over 
        the direction the trail will follow if moving while casting.

    - Troll
      - Increased Troll size back to 0.8

    - All Enemy units
      - Increased gold drop with 20%

    - Blue Horde unit
       - Increased gold drop with 40%

  -General settings
    -Increase start gold from 3500 -> 4000

Community initiated:

  - Item drops:
    - Increased the gold bag size with 40 % and added a light emitter icon on 
       top for better visibility.

  - Wave Spawn:
    - Count down timer for first wave is removed. 

  - Building Upgrades:
     - Improved Hit detection for building menu upgrades

  - Player Camera
     - Improved player camera collision and movement during collision. The 
       camera now has less collision with objects causing it to snap into the air a 
       lot less

Special thanks for submitting ideas and bugs fixed in this release to:
- Devray16
- Jaws
